commitments.detail: Ensure HVAC balancing to prevent cross-contamination
Ensure consistent air quality across both cells.
Ensure HVAC balancing to prevent cross-contamination.
Plan for 500 units to be produced.
Production will be conducted on Cell 4.
No additional HVAC balancing required as both cells share the same system.
Two LEL monitors will be deployed during the production run.
A 30-minute solvent purge will be performed at the start of the production run.
